lines.en: What did the top court rule about Myanmar?
lines.ko: 최고 법원이 미얀마에 대해 어떤 판결을 내렸나요?

lines.en: It ruled Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority.
lines.ko: 미얀마가 로힝야 소수민족을 상대로 제노사이드를 저질렀다고 판결했습니다.

lines.en: Why did the court reach this decision?
It found intent to destroy a substantial part of the population.
lines.ko: 인구의 상당부분을 파괴하려는 의도가 있었다고 판단했습니다.

lines.en: When did this military campaign happen?
It took place during a 2017 military campaign.
Why is this case important?
It is seen as a critical test for state crimes.
lines.ko: 국가 범죄를 다루는 중대한 시험대로 여겨집니다.

lines.en: How far has Voyager 1 traveled?
It is now one light-day away.
It launched in 1977 and keeps going.
Powered by curiosity and engineering alone.
Forty-nine years alone in space?
Yes, traveling nonstop without a destination.
lines.ko: 네, 목적지 없이 멈추지 않고 여행 중입니다.

lines.en: It offers a clear view of us.
We must save our pale blue dot.
lines.ko: 우리의 창문 속 푸른 점을 지켜야 해요.
